## About Me:

I work at the intersection of **technology management, IT governance, security, architecture, infrastructure, and software engineering**.

My experience includes **information security governance, technology architecture, software engineering, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, automation, and digital transformation**. I have worked with both application-level and organizational concerns, from designing software and cloud environments to supporting security assessments, governance processes, regulatory requirements, and technology-related decision making.

On the engineering side, I work primarily with **Java, Spring Boot, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Kotlin, SQL/NoSQL databases, Docker, Terraform, AWS, and Azure**. I also have experience with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, API design, authentication, automated testing, DevSecOps practices, data modeling, and AI-enabled systems.

I value technology decisions that are **intentional, sustainable, secure, and aligned with business objectives**. My goal is not simply to build systems, but to understand how technology can be structured and governed to create reliable and meaningful outcomes.

## Selected Areas of Work

### Security & Technology Governance

Experience supporting information security and governance processes involving **regulatory requirements, third-party and supplier security, vulnerability management, security assessments, evidence management, reporting, and control implementation**.

My work in this area combines technical understanding with governance requirements to help translate security expectations into structured and actionable processes.

### Software & Solution Architecture

Experience designing and implementing applications across **backend, frontend, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and distributed components**.

I focus on maintainability, traceability, security, scalability, and clear separation of responsibilities when making architectural decisions.

### Cloud & Infrastructure

Hands-on experience designing and deploying cloud-based environments using **AWS, Azure, Docker, Terraform, Linux, networking, load balancing, and infrastructure automation**.

### Automation & Intelligent Systems

Experience building **workflow automation, data-driven processes, AI-enabled components, and intelligent systems**, with an emphasis on practical integration rather than technology for its own sake.
